Select a region row before editing it. ID, Length, Minimum/Maximum Length and Default Margin are text editors (plain fill, Tab); Unit, Orientation, Alignment and Pack are ExtJS lists (open the list, click the option, Tab). Set Unit and Orientation before Alignment, Pack and Maximum Length, because rows appear and disappear with them (Fill hides Alignment and Pack; FormUnit hides Minimum and Maximum Length). New regions from the Regions add (+) button get defaults (EXP-105: UNKNOWN<n>_USER, 1 Flex, Horizontal, Top, Start). At most one correction per field. Never delete or reorder a region and never change Type, Auto Size, Region Index or the dialog's own Margin.
